name: @pipeworx/mcp-datacube-sk

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Browse / search the DATAcube collection of Slovak statistical cubes. Filter by case-insensitive substring of the English label. Returns each matching cube's code (use it as `cube` in the other tools), label, last update date, and its ordered list of dimension codes.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against dataset labels (e.g. "population", "unemployment"). Omit to list everything.

tools.name: dataset_dimensions
tools.description: List the dimensions of one cube, in path order, with each dimension's valid value codes and labels. Selections in get_data are positional and must follow this dimension order. Get the cube code from list_datasets.

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Pull data for a cube as JSON-stat. Provide one selection per dimension, in the dimension order returned by dataset_dimensions. Each selection is either a single value code, a comma-separated list of codes (e.g. "SEX_M,SEX_F"), or the literal "all" for every value of that dimension. The number of selections must equal the cube's dimension count. Output is JSON-stat: `value` is the flat data array, `dimension`/`size`/`id` describe its shape.

selections.description: One entry per dimension, in dataset_dimensions order. Each is a value code, a comma-separated list of codes, or "all". Example for as1001rs: ["2024", "UKAZ01", "all"].

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datacube-sk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datacube-sk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
